doc: A mixin: `…ForSequenceClassification` over a decoder (a classifier, a reranker, a reward model): the base model's layers and final norm, no language-model head, and the LAST prompt token's final-norm row through `score` (a bias-free Linear to the labels) as the class's output — an Embedding-profile row of `num_labels` logits, not normalised (`OutputSpec::Classify`). `num_labels` is the length of `id2label` (transformers' PretrainedConfig.num_labels; 2 when the configuration names none). transformers picks the last NON-PAD token of each row; this class reads the last token of the prompt, which is the same when the prompt holds no pad token id. `tie_word_embeddings` is read and has no effect: there is no vocabulary head.
